applicability: Shannon-Nyquist sampling-rate criterion check for a declared dataset sample rate against its declared maximum signal frequency
assumptions: the declared max_signal_frequency_hz accurately bounds the real signal content
excluded: confirmation that an anti-aliasing filter was applied
uncertainty: Standard textbook signal-processing theorem (Nyquist 1928, Shannon 1949); hand-verified before use (fs=44100,fmax=20000 -> satisfied; fs=8000,fmax=20000 -> violated).
limits_policy: A declared sample rate below twice the declared maximum signal frequency is flagged as an aliasing risk rather than accepted.
